title: fix(desktop): clear adoptedRunningTurn at every turn boundary
claim: A stale adoptedRunningTurn=true (left when an adopted turn ends by Stop/error/heartbeat instead of a normal message.complete) must not force hydrateFromStoredSession over the next turn this window originates itself; genuinely adopted turns (incl. subagent watch windows that receive a mirrored message.start) must still hydrate.

evidence.red: Tests only on MAIN: `npx vitest run src/app/session/hooks/use-prompt-actions/index.test.tsx src/app/session/hooks/use-prompt-actions/rewind.test.ts src/app/session/hooks/use-message-stream/session-info-side-effects.test.tsx` -> 2 failed | 194 passed: index.test.tsx:2163 'clears a leaked adoptedRunningTurn on a fresh submit' AssertionError: expected false to be true (seeds.every(s => s.adoptedRunningTurn === false)); rewind.test.ts:691 'restore/edit/regenerate arms clear a leaked adoptedRunningTurn' AssertionError: expected true to be false. Child-mirror guard passes on MAIN.
evidence.negative_control: (a) Each new line changed to `adoptedRunningTurn: state.adoptedRunningTurn` in submit.ts + rewind.ts -> both new tests fail again (2 failed | 176 passed); restored. (b) Rejected v1 variant (clear at message.start, no local-origin clears) -> child-mirror guard fails: session-info-side-effects.test.tsx:401 AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to be called with arguments: [ 3, null, 'session-active' ].

notes: REWORKED after lead review. v1 (commit 0a78b08d7a) cleared the flag at message.start on the premise 'an adopted turn never replays message.start' - FALSE on MAIN for subagent watch windows: lazy watch resume returns running=true (use-session-actions/index.ts:2264 sets adoptedRunningTurn) and tui_gateway agent_callbacks.py:59-62 _mirror_subagent_to_child emits a synthetic message.start on the first relayed event, so v1 would have suppressed the child-transcript hydrate (regression; now pinned by the child-mirror guard test, which fails on v1). v2 (commit 6125946f9c, branch force-updated, parent = MAIN) clears only at local-origin points: submit.ts seedOptimistic and rewind.ts applyReloadOptimistic/applyRewindOptimistic (watch windows have no composer). Accepted remainder: backend-originated next turns (queue drain elsewhere, goal follow-up) can still inherit a leaked flag and merely hydrate a turn whose prompt this window did not author. Dropped from fork: session-info running=false reset (regression risk vs #119569 reordered complete), cancelRun/interrupted/fail resets, message.start reset, 2 new test files, Playwright e2e spec, kanban baggage. NOT_TESTED: live Electron adopt->Stop->next-submit run; a queue-drain seed racing a heartbeat-settled adopted turn's late complete is a pre-existing race not addressed here. Worktree: /mnt/.../wt/A1/fork-29 (sparse then full). No git stash used.
lead_review: Lead review rejected v1 (commit 0a78b08d7a, message.start reset): reachable regression for subagent watch windows — methods_session.py:893 lazy resume reports running=true, use-session-actions:2264 sets adoptedRunningTurn, agent_callbacks.py:59-62 child mirror emits a synthetic message.start mid-run, so v1 cleared the flag and skipped the persisted child-transcript hydrate. v2 (6125946f9c) clears only at local-origin sites (submit seed, reload/rewind optimistic arms; watch windows have no composer) and adds a guard test that fails on v1. Residual edge acknowledged in body: queue-drain submit racing an adopted turn's late reordered message.complete (#119569).
